prompt:
Create ONE polished 1536×1024 desktop ecommerce hero SECTION mockup for The Peach Bucket. This must look like a complete, professionally designed above-the-fold website screenshot, NOT a standalone product photograph, moodboard or poster. Render edge-to-edge with no device frame, browser chrome, external labels or annotations. Use a warm cream background #FFF9F2, deep muted teal #24594F for text and buttons, soft peach #F1BEA9 for the product panel, and restrained kraft tones from the original product photograph. Use a clean humanist sans-serif such as Manrope: bold, tightly spaced headline; regular, comfortably spaced body copy. Maintain strong contrast and generous whitespace.

LAYOUT: A 104px-high navigation bar with 80px horizontal margins. On the left, render the text wordmark 'The Peach Bucket' in approximately 30px semibold teal. On the right, render the navigation items 'What's inside', 'Setup support', and 'FAQs' in 18px text with generous spacing. Add a subtle pale rule beneath the navigation. Below, use two columns with approximately 80px outer margins, 56px gutter and 660px width per column. Keep the whole purchase decision area visible inside the canvas.

LEFT COLUMN: Begin around y=170 with the small 18px eyebrow '6-in-1 Child Safety Kit'. Under it, render this exact headline in approximately 64px bold type with 1.06 line height and these line breaks: 'Newly crawling?' / 'Start childproofing' / 'here.'. Below, render this exact supporting copy in approximately 25px type with 35px line height, wrapping naturally within the column: 'One kit for edges, corners, sockets, cabinets, fridge access and doors—with 1-to-1 installation video support.' Place the price '₹3,299' beneath it in approximately 46px bold teal. On the next line, render 'Save ₹299 with prepaid payment.' in 21px medium-weight text. Beneath the offer, place a solid teal rounded rectangle button approximately 250×64px with cream text 'Shop the kit' in 22px bold. Beneath the button, place the understated underlined text link 'See what's inside' in 18px. Keep spacing comfortable and prevent any overlaps.

RIGHT COLUMN: Place a large peach-tinted panel with softly rounded corners from approximately x=796, y=178, width=660, height=680. Use the supplied ORIGINAL product-3.webp as the main product visual, composited as a photographic image and fitted proportionally within the panel with generous inner margins. Preserve the actual kraft compartmented box, peach/teal branding, transparent edge roll with red adhesive liner, clear L-shaped corner guards, white cabinet straps, triangular white socket protectors, white C-shaped foam door guards, and grey/white fridge locks exactly as photographed. Do not redraw, duplicate, remove, rearrange or invent components; do not alter packaging or add product labels. Preserve the original visible component count without calling out quantities. Do not crop out any product components. If needed, extend only the surrounding neutral background to fit the composition. Retain natural photographic shadows; do not introduce decorative objects or a child. Beneath the photograph, inside the panel, render these two exact centered caption lines in 21px teal: 'Edges • Corners • Sockets' and 'Cabinets • Fridge access • Doors'. These are category labels, not quantities.

BOTTOM NOTE: Around y=925, below both columns, render this exact readable 18px teal sentence: 'A starting layer, not whole-home protection. Adult supervision is always necessary.'

All visible interface copy must be exactly the text specified above. Original text already present inside the supplied product photograph may remain unchanged. Do not add reviews, ratings, badges, certifications, countdowns, scarcity, shipping promises, discount percentages, safety guarantees or policy seals. No extra navigation icons. Do not use product-7.png in this hero. The finished result should feel warm, practical and purchase-ready, with the headline, actual kit, price and CTA immediately legible.
